criterionResults.result: Real SVG pixels prove half-transparent shape and antialiased text base alpha is applied once, with multi-clips, moving/releasing/deleting base; structural invalid links release explicitly without guessing rebind.

All 16 modes independently compared between W3C CPU implementation and actual CanvasScene→serializeExport→Resvg, at partial/empty backdrop and every pixel of translucent antialiased ellipse edges. Premultiplied error ≤2 bytes.
Nested scaled/rotated parent, text+adjustment filter, base internal multiply/screen/hue, selected-layer export, project reopening, undo, and full-chain merge real pixels pass.

Locked create/release and implicit structural release are blocked; same-parent contiguous ordered base links reject missing/cross-parent/circular/interrupted imports; group duplication remaps internal links.

risks: Pixel evidence uses Resvg against the same actual SVG source; a Tauri/WebKit screenshot session was not run.

Partial-chain merges or chain merges including hidden members explicitly refuse without mutation. Full visible chain merges preserve base blend semantics. A group participating in an external clipping chain cannot be ungrouped until released/merged. These boundaries are documented in docs/user-guide/layer-clipping.md.
